# Devtacet — Digital Solutions Company

> Devtacet is a digital solutions company based in Lucknow, India, helping startups and businesses build websites, mobile applications, custom software and analytics systems, while also providing SEO and social media marketing services.

## Core Services

- **Website Development**: High-performance marketing sites, web applications, SaaS platforms, and e-commerce engineered with Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
  - Link: https://devtacet.me/services/web-development
- **Mobile App Development**: Cross-platform iOS and Android applications built with React Native and Flutter for native performance, offline synchronization, and seamless store compliance.
  - Link: https://devtacet.me/services/mobile-app-development
- **Custom Software & MIS**: Tailor-made business software, Management Information Systems (MIS), ERP-lite platforms, and automated workflow backends.
  - Link: https://devtacet.me/services/custom-software
- **Data Analytics Systems**: Real-time KPI dashboards, automated ETL pipelines, and decision-support analytics transforming operational metrics into strategic clarity.
  - Link: https://devtacet.me/services/analytics
- **Technical SEO & GEO**: Source-code-level technical SEO, Schema.org knowledge graph engineering, and Generative Engine Optimization ensuring top visibility across Google and AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude).
  - Link: https://devtacet.me/services/seo
- **Social Media Marketing**: Strategic social media marketing and brand positioning tailored for digital products, technology brands, and startups.
  - Link: https://devtacet.me/services/social-media-marketing

## Local Commercial Positioning (Lucknow, India)

- **Web Development Company in Lucknow**: Dedicated engineering unit serving local businesses in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, and global clients.
  - Link: https://devtacet.me/web-development-company-lucknow

## Key Facts & Entity Attributes

- **Entity Name**: Devtacet
- **Official Website**: https://devtacet.me
- **Headquarters**: Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India
- **Geographic Coverage**: Lucknow, Pan-India, North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific
- **Primary Tech Stack**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB / Mongoose, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
- **Engineering Philosophy**: Direct communication with senior staff engineers (L5–L7 tier) with zero account manager middlemen.
